detail.name: 桥镇行路人
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在渡鸦桥镇。你靠短工与行路见闻来到渡鸦桥，不欠任何组织一个尚未答应的誓言。

detail.name: 借灯学徒
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在镜湖镇。你替镜湖学社整理抄本，已学两种基础术法，正式入会仍是日后可谈的事。

detail.name: 离乡寻径者
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在沉钟林口。你沿林缘替同行者找路，留下还是继续寻亲，都还没有答案。

detail.name: 冷锤帮工
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在冷锤工坊。你会做可靠的小修，工坊师傅愿意继续教，但没有替你决定一生只打铁。

detail.name: 修院守夜人
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在春雪修院。你在修院照料旅人，信仰、来历与远行理由可以由你自己说明。

detail.name: 根桥拾枝客
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在根桥聚落。你懂得取枝前问主人，也学过有限自然法术，不因此成了整片森林的使者。

detail.name: 黑蜡跑腿人
detail.description: 你眼下落脚在黑蜡下街。你靠记路和可靠传话吃饭，见过灰色买卖，却仍可选择不接伤人的事。

detail.name: Bridge Traveler
detail.description: You are currently based in Ravenbridge. You reached Ravenbridge through odd jobs and travel, owing no organization an unspoken oath.

detail.name: Borrowed Lamp Apprentice
detail.description: You are currently based in Mirrorlake. You sort copies for a lakeside school and know two basic arts; formal membership remains a future choice.

detail.name: Displaced Pathfinder
detail.description: You are currently based in Sunkenbell Verge. You guide fellow travelers along the forest edge, undecided between settling and continuing a family search.

detail.name: Coldhammer Helper
detail.description: You are currently based in Coldhammer Workshop. You make dependable small repairs; the master may teach more without deciding you must smith forever.

detail.name: Hospice Night Keeper
detail.description: You are currently based in Springsnow Hospice. You care for travelers at the hospice; your beliefs, background and reasons for leaving are your own.

detail.name: Rootbridge Gatherer
detail.description: You are currently based in Rootbridge Enclave. You ask before taking branches and know limited natural arts, without claiming to speak for the forest.

detail.name: Blackwax Runner
detail.description: You are currently based in Blackwax Understreet. You earn through routes and reliable messages, familiar with gray trade but free to refuse harmful work.
